derivedRouteEvidence.method: Routes carrying evidence=derivedPlanCorpusVerified were not reviewed by hand. Their tag and memberCount come from scripts.game_data.memorypack.derived_schema, whose plans reproduce the frozen buff_actions reader's framing on 209 of 209 tags it also admits and close the exported BuffData family end to end.
derivedRouteEvidence.corpusVerification: Each was then reached on exported SkillData, where this decoder checks the route's memberCount against the payload's own member-count byte. Every one was verified that way on at least one file with no mismatch, which is why only reached routes were added: an unreached route would be an assertion.
derivedRouteEvidence.boundary: A derived route is corroborated framing, not a reviewed route. Its member count is checked on every file that reaches it, so a wrong one fails closed rather than producing plausible values; nothing here establishes the meaning of a field, and the originally reviewed rows remain the stronger evidence.
